task: Disk-backed B+tree (ae.btree) over a pinning LRU buffer pool with free-list reuse and an invariant checker
reasoning_summary: Layered PageFile, BufferPool and BPlusTree with documented page layout; deletes unlink empty nodes instead of rebalancing. Tests are differential against TreeMap with check() after every mutation, plus persistence, corruption and pool-exhaustion cases. First run failed because my tiny-pool test violated the pool>=height+3 assumption; fixed the test fixture, and a mutation of the leaf-unlink rule is caught.
